question_text: A government employee, Mr. Cruz, was found to have used his official position to recommend his cousin's construction company for a public works project, resulting in a contract award. The Ombudsman is considering whether this is a violation of RA 6713 or RA 3019. Which of the following best distinguishes the two laws in this context?

options.text: RA 6713 covers ethical breaches like nepotism, while RA 3019 covers corrupt practices like graft, and the same act may violate both.
RA 6713 only applies to elected officials, while RA 3019 applies to all public employees.
RA 3019 has stricter penalties, so it always takes precedence over RA 6713 in prosecuting such acts.
RA 6713 prohibits any recommendation of relatives, while RA 3019 only prohibits acts that involve monetary gain.
